notes.title: LINUX version released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

We are happy to announce that Dawn of Mages has launched for Linux too.
It is early access.
Have fun and feel free to report bugs on [url=steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FfDWNXxvnY3]Discord[/url].

[b]Note: Linux and Windows players CAN play together, in the same lobby.[/b]

Sincerely,
TwoShrinks

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
This is a small patch containing a myriad of small fixes all over the game. Some of them are listed below:

- Lumen performance update
- TSR adjustments
- Character movement adjustments
- Spell balances, mainly damage adjustments, but also some visuals and audio
- Map fixes (navigation, BREACH spots, artifacts, etc)
- UI fixes (to be continued in next patches)
- other

notes.title: Patch notes, Early Access
notes.notes:
Patch notes, Early Access, 07.Apr.2024

SERVERS
- fixed custom server name - displays correctly now

SPELLS
- Lightning ultimate - adjusted audio
- Fire ultimate - fix for homing mode. Spell was not dissapearing when target died before hit

MOVEMENT
- climbing is now faster

MAPS
- adjusted various props on Delirium Map
- modified text in Lobby. It is more visible and explanatory

OTHER
- adjusted lights in menu
- adjusted marketplace UI
- various other fixes

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Based on our first feedback from the community, we modified/added the following:
[list]
[*]Modified the stairs from the pool for a better navigation flow
[*]Adjusted Health PowerUp height and visibility
[*]More challenging bots - they now use the "Close" class of spells too
[*]Added AMD FidelityFX 2.2 - more FPS for everybody
[*]Adjusted lights and shadows for better performance
[*]Fixed a bug in the AoE spell class
[/list]
